summary: The registrant, TPG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund, filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose routine monthly distributions declared on April 23, 2026, with net amounts ranging from $0.1824 to $0.2000 per share payable on May 27, 2026, and to report its net asset value per share as of March 31, 2026, which was $25.2181 for each class, along with aggregate NAV of $2.5 billion and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.79x. It also provided an update on its ongoing continuous public offering of up to $5.0 billion in shares, having issued approximately 102.4 million shares for total consideration of $2.5952 billion through April 1, 2026. This filing is a routine periodic disclosure of distributions, NAV, and offering status, not a special situation event.
